searchText: one more data point: one large staking provider which uses CL-triggered exits as its main exit path said their clients specifically request an exit through the provider's API or app, and consequently the provider signs and broadcasts it with the validator key right away. This is preferred over exiting via WC because it's free and avoids custody workflows (approvals, gas, touching WCs/cold keys). The provider's concern is also that without CL-triggered exits, operators would lose any way to exit unilaterally (offboarding clients, security incidents/key compromise).
